$comment: The delivery layer probablyfine-site and personal-site share. probablyfine-site is the source of truth; scripts/shared/sync-shared.mjs applies this list to a site checkout and checks it. See scripts/shared/README.md.

files.reason: Being rewritten separately. Only the example project path in a comment differs between the sites. Move it to a template once the rewrite lands.

perSite.$comment: Deliberately not shared. The sites share plumbing, not design.
perSite.security-policy.mjs: Each site's own security headers; the generated nginx.conf and public/_headers come from it.
perSite.src/components/Icon.astro: Design layer; each site carries its own icon set.
perSite.astro.config.mjs: The blog carries a bespoke Shiki theme and integrations the portfolio has no use for.
perSite.worker/wrangler.toml: Worker name, routes and origins are all per site, and the comments explain site-specific routing (blog.probablyfine.dev bypasses the Worker).
perSite.scripts/check-tracking.mjs: Same check, different event allowlists and privacy-page wording. A candidate for shared logic with a per-site allowlist later.
perSite.public/site.webmanifest: Names and colours are per site.
perSite.package.json: Dependencies and scripts differ; each site wires the shared scripts into its own prebuild.
